# Security policy

uncoded reads the files in a project, writes the index into the project, and
runs ty through `uvx`. A vulnerability in uncoded can act with the permissions
of whoever runs it.

## Report a vulnerability

Report a vulnerability through GitHub's
[private reporting form](https://github.com/alimanfoo/uncoded/security/advisories/new).
A report there stays private.

Don't report a vulnerability in a discussion, because anyone can read a
discussion.

## What to expect

uncoded is shared, not supported. The project promises no reply to a report, and
no fix within any time.
